page.overview:
Who is Peron?

Peron (played by Josie Davis) is Scorpion's sidekick, introduced and appearing solely in the 15th episode of Mortal Kombat: Conquest.

At some point Peron and Takeda where both involved with each other in some way. She lived in Zhu Zin, and according to Siro "she wasn't a popular lady in her neighborhood" and that no one really cared when she left with Scorpion.

After Takeda’s body was overtaken by Scorpion, he appeared to retain fragments of his former memories and personality. He eventually reached out to Peron and appointed her as his second-in-command. Together, the two spent considerable time recruiting new members for Scorpion’s clan in service of Shao Kahn. During this period, Scorpion also informed Peron about Sub-Zero and the Lin Kuei.

At one point, Scorpion and Peron were invited to Shao Kahn’s palace, unaware that Sub-Zero and his clan would also be present. Shao Kahn intended for the rival factions to cooperate, though Peron reacted with immediate hostility and openly opposed the idea. Upon meeting Sub-Zero, she mocked his ice powers and showed little restraint in expressing her contempt. Fearless and defiant, she even argued directly with Shao Kahn over the proposed alliance, continuing to challenge him until Scorpion intervened—appearing noticeably more cautious and intimidated than she was.
